name: frontend-project-starter
description: Frontend project initialization plugin with design-system, workflow, Iconify, and selectable component implementation templates.

interface.shortDescription: 初始化前端设计规范与组件模板
interface.longDescription: 提供前端设计系统、工作流规范、Iconify 治理和 Vben 组件规则，并附带可选择的组件实现模板。当前默认实现为 Vben + Ant Design Vue，后续可扩展其他组件实现。
defaultPrompt: Use $frontend-project-starter to initialize this frontend project with .agents rules, Codex/Claude compatibility entries, and the vben component implementation.
Use $frontend-design-system and $vben-component-rules to build this frontend page with shared components and token-backed styling.
Use $iconify-governance to add icons through the project icon barrel and keep the app offline-safe.
